Custom Screen Printing for Cripple Creek's Gaming & Tourism Community

Cripple Creek is Colorado's historic gold rush capital, reborn in the 1990s as one of three Colorado cities where limited-stakes casino gambling is legal. Today the town of about 1,200 residents operates nine active casinos and draws hundreds of thousands of visitors each year to its preserved Victorian streetscapes. The tourism and gaming industry is the primary employer here, generating demand for casino staff uniforms, event merchandise, tourism operator gear, and promotional apparel.

Cripple Creek and nearby Victor share the Cripple Creek-Victor School District — a small district serving these two Teller County communities. Local events including the Cripple Creek Ice Festival, Donkey Derby Days, and Heritage Weekend draw crowds and often call for custom merchandise and staff apparel. Despite its small resident population, Cripple Creek's high visitor volume and tourism economy make it a meaningful market for professionally branded custom apparel.
